title: Delegating to the Machine: replication package
description: Code, pre-analysis plan, results and paper for Delegating to the Machine. The raw data are not in the git repository; the redistributable raw files are uploaded to this record as data-public, built by `uv run python -m aideleg.acquire --build-deposit OUT`. The French Data Library and AIOE files, whose sources state no licence, are deposited in a separate restricted record, available on request for replication. See README.md.
